mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates through sustained monetary accommodation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed maintains stimulus.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings outlook weakens.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment above 9.0% and industrial production below 95.0 indicates dual economic stress in labor and manufacturing sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recovery momentum builds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE > 8.5% and RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95.0 indicates robust manufacturing expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates sustainably.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO > 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based consumer and housing recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment shifts rapidly.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 380,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue growth accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when RSAFS > 380000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 94.0 indicates improving manufacturing conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates stronger corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO > 94.0.
